_note: Source drawing for each picture (the 1x drawing). Paths are relative to the source folder given to scripts/pictures.py. A value may be an object: "src" the drawing, "max2x" a byte budget for the 2x file, "only1x" no 2x file, "q" its own AVIF quality. A key ending in -matte is the matte of the thing a scene lights first ("matte": true). Build 12D: out-12d/ holds stills drawn again with the other things of the one room that their camera sees (each in its world place, lit by that scene's light): scene 2 (laptop) with the coin, scene 4 with the stand, scene 5 with the coin. The PULZ screens of scenes 5 and 6 are the app in its v90 colours (out-12d s5v4-*, brainv2-*; screens made by the stills project's pt-12d/tools/pt/stills5/coach_screens_v90.py from the made up sample person's screens only). Build 12H: out-12h/ holds scenes 1 (phone), 2 and 6 drawn again with the four printed tile icons (the picture maker's ico setting, pt-12h/tools/pt/stills12h/jobs.json), and scene 2's phone tapping the first tile with the cafe's profile page on its screen.
